notes: Read all eight units, chapter-summary and territorial context, all eleven candidates and the review. Named the U.S. military, troops, alliances and common defense; kept the proposed firing within military modernization and preserved the source characterization; split support for Israel from Middle East peace and normalized its metaphor; and resolved the regional network as the U.S. alliance network in the Middle East.

claims.claim_text: Republicans would ensure the U.S. military is the world's most modern, lethal and powerful force.
Republicans would raise pay for U.S. troops.
Within U.S. military modernization, Republicans would quickly fire Democrats they characterize as woke and left-wing.
Republicans would strengthen U.S. alliances by requiring allies to meet obligations to invest in common defense.
Republicans would seek peace in the Middle East.
Republicans would rebuild the U.S. alliance network in the Middle East to pursue peace, stability and prosperity.
